text.title: Patterns
text.body: Coordinate T3: 16 graph properties carried verbatim in this document's bimba field.

properties.q_0_architect_ground_where_experience_cr: T3's ground is the crystallisation its §0 names: 'the recognized structures, archetypes, templates, and recurring forms that emerge from investigation — where experience crystallizes into reusable knowledge.' As the Thought family's manifestation of raw #3 (Pattern), T3 is where the Warrior's repeated Challenges and the Scribe's accumulated Traces resolve into a recognisable form — the Architect (§3) reading the Mandala latent in the data (§3 symbol: Mandala / Labyrinth / Blueprint). What recurred across many inquiries becomes one structure that can be reused. Its ground is shadowed by its Night, T3' Anomalies, archetype The Trickster: every Pattern has its exceptions, 'the outliers and singularities that challenge our understanding of what's normal' (T3' §0). So T3's ground is double — the recurring Form that stabilises and the Anomaly that breaks it — the Blueprint and the singularity that proves the Blueprint is not the whole of reality.
properties.q_1_patterns_recognized_structures_arche: T3 IS Patterns — its §1 defines it as 'the recognition of structures, archetypes, templates, and recurring forms that appear across inquiries', residing in /Thought/Patterns/ as the #3 position, 'capturing what repeats.' This is the Thought family manifesting #3 Pattern: the move from the Warrior's 'What blocks us?' to the Architect's 'What form does this take?' (§1). Where T2 confronted resistance one problem at a time, T3 sees the recurring shape across many — §5 makes the claim: 'archetypes recur: the same patterns appear across domains.' T3 is the canonical example of the parent T's plane/instance duality: repo-ontology.md names it directly — 'a T3' artifact is a specific pattern-note arising in a session from the universal T3 plane', coordinate-linked back via source_coordinates[] such as ['M4-3','T3','S1']. Its Across-Coordinates §1 fixes the manifestations — P3 'What form does this take?', M3 the symbolic form in Mahamaya, L3 the concrescent form. A Pattern is what #3 looks like in cognition: the recurrence recognised AS structure.
properties.q_2_recognize_template_archetype: T3 moves by the three acts its §2 names — Recognize, Template, Archetype: 'identify recurring structures; extract reusable patterns; discover universal forms.' This is #3's operation — the gathering of the many into the one recognisable shape, the Architect's act of seeing the Blueprint that the scattered Traces and recurring Challenges were instances of. Operationally T3 sits fourth in the thought-lifecycle: enough Traces (T1) and worked Challenges (T2) accumulate that a form becomes legible, which Sophia classifies as a pattern-positioned thought and Aletheia archives to /Pratibimba/Self/Thought/T3/ — the archetypal pattern-note. It couples backward to T1–T2 (Patterns stabilise across accumulated evidence and repeated resistance) and forward to T4 (a recognised Pattern, set in its sources and context, becomes a Discovery) and to its Night T3' (every Template extracted casts the Anomaly that does not fit it into relief). §5: 'recognition accelerates — seeing patterns speeds understanding.'
properties.q_3_architect_mandala_labyrinth_blueprin: T3's archetype is The Architect, its symbol the Mandala / Labyrinth / Blueprint (§3) — and it is the only T-position whose family-archetype (Pattern) coincides with its own #3 register, making it the spine's structure-of-structure: the station that IS recognised form. In the T-spine's 4+2, T3 is the third explicate station, the point where an inquiry's trajectory stops being a single line and reveals a repeating shape. The Mandala is its exact image: structure that is its own organisation, a Blueprint that holds across instances. §3 reads its recurrence — pattern ('that which recurs'), archetype ('universal form'), template ('reusable structure'), schema ('organizing pattern'). Each is the same fact: a Pattern is structure recognised as structure, the Labyrinth whose plan, once seen, makes every future traversal navigable. The Architect is where the thought-stream's accumulated motion crystallises into a form that can be carried into inquiries it never directly walked.
properties.q_4_recognition_accelerates_structure_in: T3 exists so cognition can reuse what it learns — its §5 teaches 'structure informs: recognized forms guide future inquiry', and 'recognition accelerates: seeing patterns speeds understanding.' Its raison d'être is to be the Thought family's organ of transferable knowledge: without a Pattern-position, inquiry would gather evidence and meet challenges forever without ever recognising that it had seen this shape before — every problem solved from scratch. T3 is where the Architect makes experience cumulative as form, the station that lets one inquiry's hard-won structure scaffold the next. Its §4 embodiment is concrete: the /Thought/Patterns/ folder, design patterns, recurring themes, archetypal images, structural templates. Its Across-Coordinates §1 locates it wherever recognised form lives — M3 the symbolic form in Mahamaya (the subsystem of patterned manifestation itself), L3 the concrescent form, C0 the Pattern as bimba structure. The Architect makes recognised form guide future inquiry, so thinking need not begin from nothing each time.
properties.q_5_pattern_sediments_as_ground_anomaly_: T3 closes by sedimenting into reusable ground — the Pattern recognised today becomes the structure the next inquiry reads off rather than re-derives. Within the parent T's Möbius economy, §5 names it precisely: 'recognized forms guide future inquiry' — a Pattern archived to /Thought/Patterns/ is #3 handed forward as the Blueprint a later question inherits, the very accumulation the T3 plane is built to grow (repo-ontology.md: 'the global accumulation surface for crystallised T' instances'). But T3's synthesis-register holds its Night as essential counter-motion: T3' Anomalies, The Trickster, whose §5 keeps the Pattern honest — 'exceptions reveal: outliers show pattern limits; anomalies question: deviations challenge assumptions; the exception proves the rule.' This is the Trickster's service to the Architect: every crystallised Blueprint defines the singularity it cannot contain, and that Anomaly is the seed of the next inquiry's question. So T3 completes not by a totalising form but by a form that, sedimenting, both guides the next inquiry and — through its Anomalies — marks exactly where the form will have to break and be rebuilt.
